# Indian Journal of Development Research (IJDR)

> A peer-reviewed, open-access, bi-annual journal on development studies, public policy and sustainable growth. Published by the Institute of Development Studies, Varanasi, India. ISSN 2249-104X.

IJDR publishes original research in development studies. All issues and articles are free to read and download. Submissions are double-blind peer reviewed (4-6 weeks); manuscripts are 5,000-7,000 words.

## Key pages
- [Home](https://ijdrpub.in/): latest issue and call for papers
- [Journal issues](https://ijdrpub.in/journals): all volumes and issues with PDFs
- [Articles](https://ijdrpub.in/articles): searchable article index with abstracts, authors and keywords
- [About IJDR](https://ijdrpub.in/about): scope, aims and publisher
- [Editorial board](https://ijdrpub.in/editorial-board)
- [Advisory board](https://ijdrpub.in/advisory-board)
- [Publisher](https://ijdrpub.in/publisher)
- [Contributor guidelines](https://ijdrpub.in/contribute): how to submit a paper
- [Contact](https://ijdrpub.in/contact)

## Machine-readable
- [Sitemap](https://ijdrpub.in/sitemap.xml)
- [RSS feed](https://ijdrpub.in/rss.xml)
- Each article page (https://ijdrpub.in/article/<id>) carries Highwire/Google Scholar citation metadata and schema.org JSON-LD.
